name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.08: Aoi Me no Ryuu
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.08 アオイメノリュウ
source:
Jinguji was asked to search for client's missing brother. While pursuing the subject who is a gang member, he meets another detective investigating this gang.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
神宫寺受托寻找委托人失踪的弟弟。追查这名帮派成员时，他遇见了另一位同样在调查该帮派的侦探。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
